about.label: ABOUT
intro: I am a strategic and data-driven professional with experience in E-commerce, vendor management, and growth strategies across international environments. Fluent in English and Spanish and with a  B1 level of German.

Skilled in performance analysis, promotional campaign management, and vendor-funded growth strategies. Experienced in defining OKRs, managing stakeholders, and working in fast-paced, agile environments with cross-functional teams
Currently seeking new opportunities in international teams, with a strong interest in expanding my skills in international commerce

timeline.company: Economic and Commercial Office of Spain in Düsseldorf
timeline.position: International Trade Advisor in the Foods Sector
timeline.description: Advise Spanish food vendors on market entry and growth strategies in Germany, ensuring alignment with local regulations.
achievements: Market performance analysis and produced sector reports with PowerBi. Use of Salesforce as a tracking system to measure vendor engagement and performance KPIs.
Coordination with stakeholders at international trade fairs such as ISM or ANUGA in Cologne, securing promotional opportunities and drafting post-event strategic roadmaps

timeline.description: Analyzed the full customer conversion funnel to detect drop-off points and propose optimizations that improved user experience.
achievements: Partnered with product teams to define feature requests, estimate business impact, and comply with legal and operational standards.
Tracked and coordinated continuous improvement using Jira, applying agile methodologies (sprints, feature prioritization) and performed the user acceptance tests.
Delivered data insights and performance metrics to stakeholders, supporting data-driven decision making across teams.

timeline.description: Acted as the main point of contact for 2 EU vendors, advising on performance growth, vendor-funded deals, and promotional activities.
achievements: Designed and implemented promotional activities to improve visibility and  conversion rates, increasing vendor margins by 15%.
Analyzed deep sales and performance data to define quarterly KPIs and identify actionable opportunities for growth.
Partnered with cross-functional teams (tech, marketing, operations) to deliver data-driven recommendations aligned with vendor objectives.
